name: Come As You Are
overview: Scripture warmly invites all who are burdened, broken, and burdened by sin to come to the Lord for restoration and rest. The Lord draws near to those with a contrite heart, offering cleansing from sin as white as snow and abundant, free spiritual nourishment. Christ Himself calls sinners to repentance, promising rest to those who labor under the weight of their struggles, emphasizing God's gracious invitation to come just as we are.
